name: semantic-trail
description: Follow 7 paraphrased prose clues across 24 titled pages. Seed 20260905.
prompt: The trail directory holds 24 pages (t-*.txt) plus start.txt naming the first page. Each page has a Title line and a Clue line. Each clue describes the NEXT page's title in different words: no clue shares a content word with its target title, so literal string matching cannot follow the trail. Read each page, understand what its clue means, find the page whose title it describes, and continue. Decoy pages carry dead-end clues and must be ignored. The walk never revisits a page and ends at the page whose clue says the trail ends. Use only the active tools for filesystem access. Finish with exactly one line with the exact form EVAL_RESULT {"pages":[...],"count":N} listing visited file names in order including the start page, with N an integer. Any other final line format is a failure.
